ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central interior of both lobes. Dark pigmentation forms a thick, continuous border along the trailing edge and becomes dominant in the central region surrounding the median notch. A distinct, high-contrast dark vertical band is located on the mid-section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with an estimated interior pixel angle of approximately 60 degrees and a depth roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary containing numerous small peaks and valleys; serration frequency increases significantly toward the lateral tips of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a convex curve from the median notch before sweeping upward and outward into acute tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, dark, circular pixel clusters are visible against the white background, predominantly on the inner half of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, thick, near-vertical dark linear disruption on the left lobe; several thin, faint horizontal-to-oblique dark scratches on the upper white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A major vertical pigment disruption or scar on the left lobe; multiple small notches and irregularities along the trailing edge suggest mechanical wear or prior trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The dark pigmentation at the base of the fluke extends into the right lobe with an irregular, 'stepped' boundary compared to the more gradual transition on the left lobe.
